findings.title: Pause on mouse-opened system menu
findings.evidence: WndProc handles minimize/focus/activation and WM_SYSKEYDOWN, but has no WM_INITMENU, WM_SYSCOMMAND or WM_NCLBUTTONDOWN handler before DefWindowProc. Clicking the system-menu box keeps focus/activation on the player and does not generate WM_SYSKEYDOWN.
findings.impact: The documented system-menu pause/release guarantee misses ordinary mouse entry. Resident speaker service can continue while the modal menu tracks, unlike keyboard menu entry.
findings.recommendation: Pause before menu tracking on the Win3 menu initialization path and add a regression for mouse-opened system menu.
findings.test_gap: BUDQA.C phases 1..14 cover natural/pause/seek/minimize/focus/Escape/close, not opening system menu.
findings.verification: Source inspection only; not reproduced natively
